run.name: Whirlpool Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (WHR)
run.summary: Whirlpool's credit is weak and weakening but not in near-term distress: liquidity and a maturity runway to 2028 offset leverage of 9.52x total debt on ongoing EBITDA and negative nine-month operating cash flow. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is WHIRLPOOL CORP /DE/.

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Ongoing EBITDA (ongoing EBIT plus D&A, analyst-built), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Ongoing EBITDA 720 (ongoing EBIT 338 plus D&A 382); total debt 6,852 and cash 1,103 at 2026-09-30. LTM includes India for October and November 2025 only. Company net debt leverage is defined in the releases but not printed.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Ongoing EBITDA 1,067 over cash paid for interest 350 (10-K page:77). Analyst-built EBITDA.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash as reported. Undrawn is the 2,000 ABL, nothing drawn, plus 193 Brazil (10-Q Q3 page:21). Nominal commitment; usable availability depends on a borrowing base that is not printed.

cashflow.basis: Cash provided by (used in) operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant definitions, borrowing base availability and interim cash interest are not supplied, so headroom and usable liquidity cannot be measured.
CP-1 main limitation: Interim cash interest is not printed, and EBITDA is built by the analyst from company ongoing EBIT plus cash flow depreciation, so ratios depend on that definition.
